display_hint: Present completed media to the user. Forward attached image content blocks to the host's image display helper (for example, image(block)); do not stringify image blocks as text. For Markdown previews use previews[].preview_url, and separately link original_url as the full-resolution file. If no preview is available, show a clearly labeled original-file link. Do not claim a preview rendered unless it is visible. Video, audio and 3D URLs are original result files, not queue URLs.
